sentences.text: At the very outset, the learned A.G.A. has raised a preliminary objection with regard to the maintainability of present application.
He submits that applicants were summoned by court below by means of summoning order dated 17.07.2019.
Present application has been filed after an expiry of a period of more than three years from the date of summoning order i.e. 17.07.2019.

As such,
present application is hopelessly barred by laches.
However, the laches in filing present application have not been sufficiently explained by applicants.
As the laches in filing present application have not been sufficiently explained, therefore, applicants do not deserve any indulgence by this Court.
5. When confronted with above, the learned counsel for applicants could not overcome the same.
6. In view of above, present application fails and is liable to be dismissed on the ground of laches.
7. Accordingly, present application is dismissed on the ground of laches.
